hypothesis_title: Thalamocortical Coupling Mediates White Matter Integrity and Thalamic Morphology via DMN Connectivity in Insomnia
hypothesis_summary: This hypothesis proposes that thalamocortical coupling, as measured by thalamus_DMN_FC, modulates white matter integrity (FA) and thalamic morphology (thalamus_volume) in insomnia through interactions with the default mode network (DMN).
